metadata.description: Patched fork of bradautomates/claude-video. Same skill, plus fixes for ffmpeg 8+, non-UTF-8 Windows consoles, and manual-caption selection (upstream PRs #216, #217, #221).

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or Whisper.
